title: Tapes mention coupling to the computer data bank

tellings.quote: cuz on a lot of the tapes there's mention of um coupling to the computer data bank

plain: Many of the recorded sessions held by a scientist named Andrija Puharich in the 1970s mention coupling to a computer data bank. An unnamed researcher on the episode sums up the tapes this way, without quoting a specific one. The phrase hints that whatever spoke through the sessions described linking up with some kind of stored store of knowledge.
